Rebar Receiving Inspection Checklist 33 checkpoints across 6 sections.Upon every delivery of reinforcement steel (TMT bars, structural steel); prior to storage and use in construction Download ExcelDownload PDF **33** Checkpoints **6** Sections Once per delivery lot QA/QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 1786:2008](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1786-2008) [IS 2062:2011](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2062-2011) Related [📐IS 1786](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1786) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Reinforcement Bar Grades](https://infralens.in/handbook/rebar-grades) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. DELIVERY VERIFICATION | | A1 | Purchase Order details match delivery documents
Acceptance: Delivery challan and PO align; no discrepancies in grade or size | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 — Sampling and inspection | OK

Acceptance: Complete delivery challan received and attached to invoice | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 | OK

Acceptance: Delivered weight ±3% of ordered weight; variance documented if >3% | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Quantity tally — piece count
Acceptance: Piece count matches delivery challan; no bundles short-counted | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Heat number / batch traceability marked on bundles
Acceptance: Heat/lot number clearly marked on all bundles; matches MTC heat number | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 — Lot identification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A6 | Manufacturer identification marks visible on bars
Acceptance: Identification marks (embossed/printed) present and legible on sample bars | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.3 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. VISUAL INSPECTION | | B1 | Surface condition — no visible cracks
Acceptance: No cracks (transverse or longitudinal) on bar surface visible to naked eye | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Surface condition — no surface flaws or seams
Acceptance: Bar surface free from laminations, tears, or rolling seams; light scratches acceptable | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Rib pattern — transverse ribs present per IS 1786 Cl. 6.2
Acceptance: Two transverse ribs per side; rib spacing uniform; ribs cross both diagonal and transverse | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 — Rib geometry | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: At least two longitudinal ribs visible; unbroken along bar length | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 | OK
NC

HOLD | | B5 | Colour coding for grade identification
Acceptance: Fe 500 bars unpainted; Fe 500D bars with green paint on cut ends; consistent across lot | IS 1786:2008 practice — Grade distinction | OK
NC

HOLD | | B6 | Straightness — no visible bends or kinks
Acceptance: Bars straight within 0.5% of length; no visible kinks or permanent bends | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6 — Dimensional tolerances | OK

Acceptance: Light mill scale present; loose, flaking, or deep pitting rust not acceptable; reject if >10% bar surface affected | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 | OK

Acceptance: Bar ends square-cut; no torch cut (melted edges); no jagged edges; no end damage affecting 50mm length | IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6 | OK

DELIVERY VERIFICATION A1Purchase Order details match delivery documents IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 — Sampling and inspection (Verify order quantity, grade, and bar diameter) ✓ Delivery challan and PO align; no discrepancies in grade or size OKNCNAHOLD A2Delivery challan present with consignment IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 (Documentation of supply) ✓ Complete delivery challan received and attached to invoice OKNCNAHOLD A3Quantity tally — weight check IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 (Weight tolerance: ±3% per batch) ✓ Delivered weight ±3% of ordered weight; variance documented if >3% OKNCNAHOLD A4Quantity tally — piece count IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 (Count match for bundled bars) ✓ Piece count matches delivery challan; no bundles short-counted OKNCNAHOLD A5Heat number / batch traceability marked on bundles IS 1786:2008 Cl. 11 — Lot identification (Each bundle must be identifiable to manufacturing lot) ✓ Heat/lot number clearly marked on all bundles; matches MTC heat number OKNCNAHOLD A6Manufacturer identification marks visible on bars IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.3 (Mfg. marks: grade, plant code, month/year of production) ✓ Identification marks (embossed/printed) present and legible on sample bars OKNCNAHOLD B. VISUAL INSPECTION B1Surface condition — no visible cracks IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 (Defects must not impair serviceability) ✓ No cracks (transverse or longitudinal) on bar surface visible to naked eye OKNCNAHOLD B2Surface condition — no surface flaws or seams IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 (Laminations, seams not permitted) ✓ Bar surface free from laminations, tears, or rolling seams; light scratches acceptable OKNCNAHOLD B3Rib pattern — transverse ribs present per IS 1786 Cl. 6.2 IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 — Rib geometry (Transverse ribs on opposite faces; spacing and height critical) ✓ Two transverse ribs per side; rib spacing uniform; ribs cross both diagonal and transverse OKNCNAHOLD B4Rib pattern — longitudinal ribs present IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 (Longitudinal ribs along bar length) ✓ At least two longitudinal ribs visible; unbroken along bar length OKNCNAHOLD B5Colour coding for grade identification IS 1786:2008 practice — Grade distinction (Fe 500: no paint; Fe 500D: green paint on bar ends) ✓ Fe 500 bars unpainted; Fe 500D bars with green paint on cut ends; consistent across lot OKNCNAHOLD B6Straightness — no visible bends or kinks IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6 — Dimensional tolerances (Straightness essential for fabrication) ✓ Bars straight within 0.5% of length; no visible kinks or permanent bends OKNCNAHOLD B7Rust — light mill scale acceptable IS 1786:2008 Cl. 7.1 (Mill scale (Fe₃O₄) surface acceptable; loose rust not acceptable) ✓ Light mill scale present; loose, flaking, or deep pitting rust not acceptable; reject if >10% bar surface affected OKNCNAHOLD B8Bar ends — clean cut, no torch cut or damage IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6 (Bar ends prepared by shearing or sawing) ✓ Bar ends square-cut; no torch cut (melted edges); no jagged edges; no end damage affecting 50mm length OKNCNAHOLD C. DIMENSIONAL CHECK C1Diameter measurement — vernier calipers or micrometer IS 1786:2008 Table 3 — Dimensional tolerances (Diameter tolerance: ±0.6mm for ≤10mm; ±8% of nominal for >10mm (Table 3)) ✓ Measure 3 positions per bar, 5 random bars per lot. All measurements within tolerance. Document min/max values. OKNCNAHOLD C2Length check — measured against nominal length IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.1 (Standard length tolerance per supply contract) ✓ Length tolerance ±50mm per IS 1786; document actual lengths if coil-cut supply OKNCNAHOLD C3Rib height measurement per IS 1786 Cl. 6.2 IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 — Rib geometry (Fe 500D) (Minimum rib height: 0.07d where d = bar diameter) ✓ Measure 5 ribs per bar; min height ≥0.07d; document if below minimum OKNCNAHOLD C4Rib spacing measurement — transverse rib spacing IS 1786:2008 Cl. 6.2 (Transverse rib spacing per IS 1786 specification) ✓ Spacing uniform; within ±0.5mm variation across 5 sample bars; document spacing for Fe 500D OKNCNAHOLD Showing 18 of 33 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off ACCEPTED — All checkpoints OK; proceed to use ACCEPTED WITH NCR — Specific non-conformances documented; NCR raised; use conditionally per approval REJECTED — Critical non-conformances; return to supplier Overall Verdict Name / Sign / Date Number of NC Items Name / Sign / Date NCR Number (if applicable) Name / Sign / Date Inspector Signature Name / Sign / Date Engineer Approval Signature Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
